cases.name: Home page loads
cases.steps: Open / ; wait for brand text and navigation
cases.expected: Page renders the brand, hero, nav links to Explore, with no console errors or failed API calls
cases.actual: Title "Hamro Prachin Sampada · हाम्रो प्राचीन सम्पदा", 6 explore links, 628 chars of text

cases.name: Explore: map and list render
cases.steps: Open /explore ; wait for the monument list and map canvas
cases.expected: List shows 100+ monuments and the MapLibre canvas exists
cases.actual: 116 list rows rendered, map canvas present

cases.name: Explore: province filter and search
cases.steps: Open /explore ; click province chip Lumbini ; count rows ; clear ; type "Pashupati" in search ; open first result
cases.expected: Province chip narrows list to only that province; search finds Pashupatinath and the detail card offers "Open the story"
cases.actual: All=116, Lumbini=11 (all Lumbini), search "Pashupati" -> 2 hits, detail card opened

cases.name: Monument detail page
cases.steps: Fetch catalogue ; open /m/<slug> of Pashupatinath ; read heading
cases.expected: Page shows the monument name as the main heading, with no console errors or failed API calls
cases.actual: /m/pashupatinath h1="Pashupatinath Temple"

cases.name: Monument 3D model viewer
cases.steps: Open /m/<slug>?view=model&still=1 ; wait for .model-viewer[data-ready="1"] canvas
cases.expected: WebGL canvas for the site-specific procedural model appears and is marked ready
cases.actual: canvas 829x440 ready

cases.name: Gallery and lightbox
cases.steps: Open monument ; wait for gallery ; click "N photos" ; verify lightbox opens ; press Escape
cases.expected: Gallery thumbnails render, lightbox opens full screen and closes with Escape
cases.actual: 7 thumbnails; lightbox opened (still mounted after Esc)

cases.name: Register a new explorer, then log out
cases.steps: Open /register ; fill name, email, password, pick an interest ; submit ; arrive at /verify ; Skip for now ; open user menu ; Log out
cases.expected: Account is created, user lands on verification page and can skip; logout removes the avatar from the nav
cases.actual: Registered e2e1793782022099@example.com, verify page reached, skipped, logged out

cases.name: Login with demo account and logout
cases.steps: Open /login ; enter demo@sampada.np / explorer123 ; submit ; verify redirect ; log out
cases.expected: Valid demo credentials sign in and redirect to /passport; avatar appears; logout removes it
cases.actual: Signed in as demo, landed on /passport, logged out

cases.name: Login rejects a wrong password
cases.steps: Open /login ; enter demo email with a wrong password ; submit
cases.expected: An inline alert is shown and the user stays on /login (401 expected)
cases.actual: Alert: "Email or password is incorrect"

cases.name: Yatra planner builds a route
cases.steps: Open /walk ; choose an interest chip ; press the plan button ; wait for timeline
cases.expected: A timeline with at least 2 stops and a Google Maps link is produced
cases.actual: 17 stops in route, Google Maps link present

cases.name: Adaptive quiz trail
cases.steps: Open /quiz ; Start the trail ; answer 5 questions, pressing Next each time
cases.expected: Each answer shows right/wrong feedback and the rating chip is present; the question advances
cases.actual: Answered 5 questions with feedback; rating chip "908"

cases.name: Find the Monument round
cases.steps: Open /find ; Start the game (Kathmandu Valley) ; click the map to drop a pin ; Lock my guess
cases.expected: A round starts with a photo and clue; pin can be placed; the result step appears with Next round / See results
cases.actual: Round 1 submitted and result step shown

cases.name: Passport: stamps and badges (demo explorer)
cases.steps: Login as demo ; open /passport ; count badges and UNESCO zones ; open a monument and press "I am here" (manual stamp) ; reopen /passport
cases.expected: Passport shows badge grid and seven UNESCO zones; the manual stamp appears as a stamp card
cases.actual: 11 badges, 7 UNESCO zones, 1 stamp(s) after manual stamp

cases.name: Leaderboard
cases.steps: Open /leaderboard
cases.expected: Heading and the quiz and game boards (or empty states) render
cases.actual: Leaderboard heading present

cases.name: Verify page
cases.steps: Open /verify logged out (expect redirect to /login) ; register a fresh explorer and land on /verify ; check code form ; login as verified demo and open /verify
cases.expected: Anonymous users go to /login; an unverified explorer sees the six-digit code form; an already verified explorer is sent on to /passport
cases.actual: unverified user sees code form; verified demo is redirected from /verify to /passport

cases.name: Forgot password page
cases.steps: Open /forgot ; enter email ; submit
cases.expected: Form appears and moves to the code / new-password step without errors
cases.actual: Reset code requested, second step shown

cases.name: Admin login and screens
cases.steps: Login as admin@sampada.np ; land on /admin ; click every admin tab
cases.expected: Admin is redirected to /admin; each tab (dashboard, monuments, explorers, reviews, activity) renders content
cases.actual: Tabs rendered: Dashboard:1786, Monuments & quiz:1718, Explorers:1097, Reviews:712, Activity:810

cases.name: Admin route is protected for explorers
cases.steps: Login as demo ; open /admin
cases.expected: A non-admin user is redirected away from /admin and sees no admin tabs
cases.actual: Redirected to /

cases.name: 404 page
cases.steps: Open /no-such-page
cases.expected: Friendly "This lane leads nowhere" page with Home and map links
cases.actual: 404 page rendered

cases.name: Mobile 375x812: home has no horizontal overflow
cases.steps: Set viewport 375x812 ; open / ; compare scrollWidth with clientWidth
cases.expected: No horizontal scroll
cases.actual: scrollWidth 375 <= clientWidth 375

cases.name: Mobile 375x812: monument page has no horizontal overflow
cases.steps: Set viewport 375x812 ; open /m/<slug>
cases.expected: No horizontal scroll and the heading is visible
cases.actual: scrollWidth 375 <= clientWidth 375

cases.name: Mobile 375x812: other pages have no horizontal overflow
cases.steps: Set viewport 375x812 ; open /explore, /walk, /quiz, /find, /leaderboard, /login, /about
cases.expected: No page scrolls horizontally
cases.actual: 7 pages fit within 375px

cases.name: Polish: image alt text and internal links
cases.steps: Open /, /explore, /m/, /about, /credits ; collect without alt and internal ; request each link from the dev server
cases.expected: Every has an alt attribute; every internal link returns 200
cases.actual: 127 unique internal links all 200, no img missing alt

cases.name: Server unit tests (npm test)
cases.steps: Run npm test in server/
cases.expected: 12 algorithm unit tests (tour planner vs brute force, Elo, SM-2, scoring, recommender) pass
cases.actual: pass 12, fail 0

cases.name: Server API tests (npm run test:api)
cases.steps: Run npm run test:api in server/ against the running API
cases.expected: 18 API tests (catalogue, auth, walk, quiz, stamps, find, admin) pass
cases.actual: pass 18, fail 0

cases.name: Live hunt simulation (hunt-sim.mjs)
cases.steps: Run node test/hunt-sim.mjs : 3 players join a Socket.io room and play 3 rounds
cases.expected: Room created, duplicate name and non-host start refused, 3 reveals, final ranking printed
cases.actual: ranking: 1.Host 189, 2.Aarati 189, 3.Bikash 5
